scenes.description: David Perry, a 35-year-old restaurant server, is at the office of a mobile home community. He's hesitant and anxious about his decision to potentially move here after being evicted from his old apartment. He is joined by two neighbors, Chen and Lily, who are supportive and curious about his situation.

actions.dialogue: Hey David, I thought you might be interested in this place. We've got affordable rates and a great community here!

actions.action: Places a hand on David's shoulder
actions.dialogue: It's okay to feel unsure, David. I remember when I first moved in. It felt like a big change, but it turned out to be a good one.

actions.action: Looks at the flyer and sighs
actions.dialogue: I really need something stable and affordable. I've been in my old apartment for years, and the thought of moving is... stressful.
But this place is way cheaper, and the community is tight-knit. You won't be alone here.
I just need to make sure it's secure. I've been through too much instability already.

scenes.plot: David is considering a move to a new mobile home community after being evicted from his apartment. He is met by Chen, who offers him a flyer, and Lily, who comforts him. David weighs the pros and cons of moving, focusing on stability, affordability, and security.
scenes.social_purpose: To explore David's background, values, and personality through a realistic social interaction involving housing alternatives and community support.

chunk.text: David Perry stands at the entrance of the mobile home community, torn between staying in his familiar apartment and considering a new, potentially better option. As he looks at the flyer Chen gave him, Lily offers her support, helping him process the decision in a socially engaging setting.
